listenings.text: Hello, and welcome back to the book corner. Today's book is Quantum Marketing, by Raja Rajamannar, a marketing leader at Mastercard. The main message is simple: marketing is changing very fast, and the old methods will not be enough. The author talks about new channels, about data, and about artificial intelligence. He also talks a lot about trust. If brands use customer data without care, people will stop trusting them. My opinion? It is a good book for managers. It is not a very technical book, so you can read it on a weekend. But one idea stays with me: if marketers don't learn about technology, they will be left behind.

Hi, it's Katrin again. My director asked me: what will CRM look like in five years? Here are my three predictions. First, emails will be more personal. Every customer will get a different message, at a different time. Second, we will send fewer messages. If customers get too many emails, they will unsubscribe, and they won't come back. So less is more. Third, chatbots. They will answer the simple questions, day and night. But for a problem, people will still want to talk to people. If a brand forgets that, it will lose loyalty. Of course, I can't predict the future. But the data tells a story.
